best_idea: Unroll the inner k-loop in the 4x4 micro-kernel by a factor of 4 to reduce loop overhead and improve instruction-level parallelism, while handling remainder iterations.

best_lineage.idea: Replace naive triple loop with cache-blocked, NEON-vectorized micro-kernel (4x4) using column-major A-panel and row-major B-panel packing, with loop order j-NC, i-MC, k-KC for better memory locality and register reuse.
Fix the NEON micro-kernel by broadcasting scalar values from float32x2_t to float32x4_t using vdupq_lane_f32 before passing to vfmaq_laneq_f32, which requires a float32x4_t as its third argument.

Replace vfmaq_laneq_f32 with vfmaq_n_f32 in the micro-kernel to eliminate explicit broadcast instructions; vfmaq_n_f32 takes a scalar directly (extracted via vgetq_lane_f32), reducing instruction count per k-iteration from ~12 to ~8 while computing the same 4x4 outer product.
Unroll the inner k-loop in the 4x4 micro-kernel by a factor of 4 to reduce loop overhead and improve instruction-level parallelism, while handling remainder iterations.
